fields.description: Total weekly-hours threshold at which overtime changes from +35% to +100%. Example: 68 with 44 expected hours permits 24 hours at +35%.
fields.label: Max Weekly Extra Hours

fields.description: Especifique el monto por cada dependiente inscrito en el seguro para hacer la correcta deducción en la nómina.
fields.label: Monto por Dependiente

fields.description: Legacy mode keeps balanced excluded Salary Component rows. Dedicated mode stores employer contributions separately and posts them directly in the payroll accrual Journal Entry.
fields.label: Employer Contribution Accounting Mode
fields.options:
Salary Component Pairs
Dedicated Journal Entries

fields.description: Monthly employer INFOTEP percentage. Law 116-80 establishes 1% of salary payroll; commissions are included by the TSS reporting guide.
fields.label: INFOTEP Employer Rate

fields.description: Company-specific SRL percentage. The DEV default reflects the 1.20% rate used in IGC payroll from February 2025 onward and must be reconciled to the production TSS classification.
fields.label: SRL Employer Rate

fields.description: Enable only after reconciling the configured SRL percentage to IGC's current TSS notification or pre-liquidation.
fields.label: SRL Rate Verified Against TSS

fields.description: Feature gate for approved overtime records and punch reconciliation. Approved Cash retroactive adjustments create linked Additional Salary earnings; Compensatory Rest remains separate.
fields.label: Enable Overtime Authorization

fields.description: Enables explicit settlement actions after attendance reconciliation. Deployment does not activate this setting.
fields.label: Enable Overtime Settlement

fields.default:
HR Manager
Accounts Manager
System Manager
fields.description: One Frappe role per line. A user must also be able to read the source overtime record.
fields.label: Settlement Roles

fields.description: Smallest leave-day credit posted to the consolidated allocation. Remaining hours stay in the overtime bank.
fields.label: Leave Credit Increment

fields.description: When enabled, an hourly idempotent job creates review-only candidates from Employee Checkins. It never creates payroll, Additional Salary, leave, or accounting records.
fields.label: Enable Overtime Candidate Generation

fields.description: Minimum delay after the scheduled shift end before a regular-workday candidate is surfaced. Legal holidays are always evaluated.
fields.label: Candidate Threshold (Minutes)

fields.description: Number of completed calendar days reevaluated by each hourly run. Existing candidates are updated idempotently until a supervisor makes a final decision.
fields.label: Candidate Lookback Days

fields.default:
Operador
Auxiliar
Mecánico
Electricista
Inspector
Prensista
Troquelador
fields.description: One designation keyword per line. Matching active plant employees are surfaced as Eligibility Pending until Overtime Eligible and Approver are configured.
fields.label: Plant Designation Keywords

fields.description: Temporary exception gate for approving already-worked overtime from Employee Checkins. Keep disabled outside the controlled historical cleanup period.
fields.label: Enable Retroactive Overtime Adjustment

fields.description: Earliest Work Date that may be submitted as a retroactive adjustment.
fields.label: Retroactive Overtime From Date

fields.description: Latest historical Work Date that may be submitted as a retroactive adjustment.
fields.label: Retroactive Overtime To Date

fields.description: Last calendar date on which an approver may submit a historical adjustment. After this date, the exception path closes automatically.
fields.label: Retroactive Overtime Submission Deadline
